text:
Emma L.: Heads-up — marketplace release next Tue. We need final alignment on driver/CUDA/ROCm pins with HW partners. A CUDA12.2 quant-kernel regression showed up in staging yesterday. Can partners confirm pinned combos we should ship with? TL;DR: propose CUDA 12.1 + driver 535, ROCm 6.3 as fallback. @Tim - HWPartner, @Micah please advise.

Raj P.: From infra runs, staging shows perf regression on A100-80GB with CUDA12.2 + driver 540. Canary with 12.1 looks stable. Logs: https://staging-logs/repro/2376543210 :eyes:

Natalie (Partnerships): Marketing needs the joint announcement date — hold until pins stable? Recommend soft freeze on public comms until canary completes.

Micah (eng-runtime): Agree with pin to 12.1/535 for GA. Plan: canary in eu-west for 24h then progressive roll. We'll add automatic fallback to ROCm variant when kernel mismatch triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary started on eu-west: redwood-canary-4; target 1.2k rps. Monitoring hooks: /canary/redwood-canary-4

Tim - HWPartner: We're seeing the same internally — driver 540 includes a cuBLAS ABI change that regresses quant kernels. HW team has a patch; ETA ~48h. We're fine if you pin to 12.1 for GA.

Emma L.: Action items: (1) Micah — create canary runbook + rollback criteria, (2) Raj — add kernel regression test to preflight, (3) Tim — share patched driver artifact + checksum, (4) Natalie — prepare standby announcement copy. I'll host a sync 11:00 AM PST tomorrow.

Micah (eng-runtime): I'll add KV-cache checks and perf guardrails. Can we pin the CUDA toolkit in the marketplace AMI (so users get deterministic builds)? If yes I'll add the AMI note in docs.

Raj P.: I'll add a fast regtest job: `./tools/regtest --gpu a100 --cuda 12.1 --driver 535` and a short CI gate. Ticket created: INFRA-2397.

Natalie (Partnerships): :thumbsup: I'll hold announcement and draft a small blurb noting a "temporary pin to CUDA 12.1 to avoid perf regressions" so partners aren't surprised.

Tim - HWPartner: Patch uploaded to S3: s3://partner-drivers/540-hotfix-2026-03-20.tar.gz sha256: abc123def456... Will update once signed.

Micah (eng-runtime): If partner patch passes internal QA we can try a targeted canary of 540+patch in 48h and swap if stable. Otherwise we stick with 12.1 pin for two weeks then re-evaluate.

Emma L.: Thanks. Adding meeting invite now. @deploy-bot please post canary metrics summary to this thread in ~6h.

metrics-bot: Canary 6h snapshot for redwood-canary-4: p95 latency +8%, token cost +2%, error rate 0.4%. Full metrics: https://metrics/reports/2376543210

Raj P.: Noted — p95 +8% looks caused by kernel fallback thrash during KV cache warmup. Suggest we temporarily lower max batch size for canary to reduce overhead.

Micah (eng-runtime): I'll test batch cap changes and report perf numbers here.

Emma L.: Great — keep updates short in this thread. We'll use the sync to lock the pin and finalize comms. :white_check_mark:
